name: Article Standard
source: Phase 5.29 - Article Automation Editorial, Freshness and Cluster Hardening
description: Measurable quality standard for clear, actionable, maintainable and well-connected future articles.

clarity: primary answer appears near the beginning
technical terms are explained on first use
density: paragraphs above 120 words are split or manually justified
heuristic findings are labeled as heuristic
flow: dependent sections declare a logical transition
no long dependent H2 stack lacks transitions
examples: complex abstract concepts have an example or recorded justification
repetition: repeated ideas add context, example, decision support or progression
keyword density does not indicate padding
intent: primary question, secondary questions and reader action are declared
freshness: update sensitivity is one approved class
mutable sections are identified for MIXED content
review dates are evidence-based or null before review
sources: official-dependent claims map to verified sources and supported sections
missing mandatory official source blocks publication
cluster: domain, nucleus, cluster, pillar and article role are resolved
links: non-pillar articles link to the pillar
seo: canonical and structured data match the intended URL
FAQ schema exactly mirrors visible FAQ
mobile: required viewports are checked when a public page is generated
tables have contained horizontal scrolling when needed
cta: CTA destinations are governed and relevant
placement follows the approved reference when applicable
faq: visible and structured FAQ remain identical

acceptanceCriteria: major warnings resolved or explicitly approved
essential panel metadata present without duplicate aliases
migrationNotes: No existing article is retrofitted by adopting this standard.

availableVersions.1.0: Initial article quality standard; retained for legacy assets.
